material_definitions: Solid solution series of the form Li(1+x)MxTi(2-x)(PO4)3.
M represents trivalent metal cations including Al, Cr, Ga, Fe, Sc, In, Y, and La.
Substitution involves replacing Ti4+ with M3+ and adding Li+ for charge compensation.
Samples were prepared with binders like Li2CO3 or (NH4)2HPO4 and sintered at 1173 K for 2h.

Substitution involves replacing Ti4+ with M3+ and adding Li+ for charge compensation.
Samples were prepared with binders like Li2CO3 or (NH4)2HPO4 and sintered at 1173 K for 2h.
Materials are NASICON-type solid solutions with the formula Li(1+x)MxTi(2-x)(PO4)3.
Single phase compositions were characterized for x values of 0.2 and 0.3.
Mixed phase samples composed of LiTi2(PO4)3 and Li3M2(PO4)3 were also evaluated.
The study investigates the impact of sintered pellet porosity on ionic conductivity.
Conductivity measurements were performed at a constant temperature of 298 K.
